notes.title: Partnership Announcement - Deep Dish Dungeon x Raw Fury
notes.notes:
We are very excited to share that we have landed a publishing agreement with Raw Fury!

Our announcement trailer with the news was revealed at the Gamescom Awesome Indies showcase. Not only that, we're showing at Gamescom this year! 

This is the beginning of a very exciting journey and we can't wait to share it with you. We'll be posting news, dev updates, and more on Steam and across our social media channels:

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/beholdstudios.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/beholdstudios]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@beholdstudios]Tiktok[/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8bzFH3lxEX0

[h1]Deep Dish Dungeon in a nutshell![/h1]

Developed by Behold Studios, Deep Dish Dungeon is a dungeon crawler and exploration game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness in an atmospheric environment.

In Deep Dish Dungeon, players will explore rooms and passageways solo or with up to three friends, and gather resources to improve their campsite. Players will be able to craft tools and cook nourishing meals to bolster strength throughout the journey, and unravel the enigma that lies within the shadows.

[list]
[*] [h3]Build, craft and cook[/h3] Forage and scavenge while traversing through the dungeon's bountiful depths. Between journeys, return to camp and plan next steps by the fire, and use resources to craft new tools and cook a hearty meal. Remember that food is progress: over time, unlock recipes that have different effects on stats.

[*] [h3]A massive dungeon to discover[/h3] Fortune favors the bold. Investigate every shadow, solve every puzzle, and open every door. The dungeon will reveal its secrets only with patience and persistence. Learn how to defeat enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and never take a hint for granted.

[*] [h3]Explore together[/h3] Any adventure is better with pals! Play with up to three friends and collaborate to unveil the secrets of the dungeon.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871520/Deep_Dish_Dungeon/?beta=0

notes.title: Cosplay Club - Early Access Dec 14th!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We're happy to annouce that this next Dec 14th we'll be launching our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Cosplay_Club/]Cosplay Club[/url] on Early Access, here on Steam. 

A couple of weeks ago, our Kickstarter backers received access to the first chapter of the game and have been enjoying it so far. Because of that immediate good response, we decided to let you all be envolved with its development through the Early Access program. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Cosplay_Club/

[h1]Why Early Access?
[/h1]
We've chosen to release Cosplay Club through Early Access to involve our community in the game's development journey. We aim to gather valuable feedback, insights, and suggestions that will help us refine and enhance the gaming experience. This collaborative approach allows us to build a game that resonates with the preferences and expectations of you all. It all started during the Kickstarter in 2022, and we want to continue exploring this path.

The duration of the Early Access phase will depend on the feedback and input we receive from you all. We are committed to delivering a polished and engaging experience, and the Early Access period will continue until we feel that the game has reached a level of quality and completeness that aligns with our vision. It will be mostly around 9 to 12 months, and even after that, we plan to continue to integrate new content.

The Early Access version serves as a foundation, offering players the core mechanics and features of Cosplay Club. Throughout the Early Access phase, we plan to introduce new content, refine gameplay elements based on player feedback, and address any identified issues.

[h1]New game's name
[/h1]
From now on, we'll be refering to our game as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Cosplay_Club/]Cosplay Club[/url]. We wanted a more friendly and catchy name, and funny enough everyone was already calling it by this name. So it makes even more sense to change it permanentely. But we all know how important the Mahou Senshi part is to us and to the game's theme, so it will be forever on our history.

[h1]We're here because of you!
[/h1]
Let's not forget how important is your collaboration in this project. Because of you we manage to get where we are, and we are finally able to make this game available to everyone else. Thank you very much for being part of our community!

[h1]Join our Discord
[/h1]
More than ever, [url=http://discord.gg/beholdstudios]our discord server[/url] will serve as a hub for everyone in the community. We'll be talking about the early access builds, patch updates, the content milestones, and everything else. Let's share some costumes over there!

[u][b]See you soon on Dec 14th![/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Cosplay_Club/

notes.title: Developers of Chroma Squad are once again back on the Kickstarter with a new RPG project
notes.notes:
[url=http://www.playcosplayclub.com][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/c3d54b91cb0e4e5fde2346796046b79a9541fe6c.png[/img][/url]

Our studio is back to the Kickstarter! We just revealed our new crowdfunding project and we're hoping to have the same success that we had in 2013 with Chroma Squad. Do you remember the manager RPG about Power Rangers and TV Show?

“Getting back to the Kickstarter once again is not for the faint-hearted. Chroma Squad in 2013 was a huge undertaken, but it was a very successful one.” said Saulo Camarotti, the lead creator of the studio. “Today we’re getting back to crowdfunding, but we want to bring more experience and maturity to the project” he completes.

The new project is called Mahou Senshi Cosplay Club, where the studio is focusing in creating a story driven RPG with their very well-known twist of mixing realities of imagination and meta reference. This time a Magical Girl gets her power from starting a journey in becoming a Cosplayer, and the game will allow you to create costumes and fight in turn-based battles using the costumes you create.

The game features a complete RPG set in a cosplaying world. You’ll have the opportunity to explore events and exhibitions to participate in cosplaying contests. Through exploration, you will expand your inventory with new materials and design parts so you can be more creative on crafting new costumes.

We're looking for support to complete the game on Kickstarter and we've put some interesting options in the pledge list, such as buying access to an early playable build of the game, or even becoming an NPC cosplayer inside the game that looks just like you and would be wearing a nice cosplay of your choice.

Mahou Senshi Cosplay Club will be heading first to PC and Major Consoles, and it is expected to release in 2023 upon the success of the Kickstarter. If you want to check out their crowdfunding page, please go to [url=http://www.playcosplayclub.com]http://www.playcosplayclub.com[/url].

[url=http://www.playcosplayclub.com][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/29be6f5339c2fbadb914e6789e9e39d621db5815.gif[/img][/url]

Behold Studios was founded in 2009 and is known for games like Knights of Pen & Paper, Chroma Squad and Out of Space. With more than 70 international awards and nominations the studio has gathered a big loyal community with their quirky pixel art RPGs along the years.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Mahou_Senshi_Cosplay_Club/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172180/Mahou_Senshi_Cosplay_Club/[/url]

notes.title: Out of Space update: Multiplayer Online up to 4 players! v0.8.01b4
From the same creators of Chroma Squad and Knights of Pen & Paper...
notes.notes:
Out of Space is now available in Early Access!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/f6d158700858e9ee8291055e33d7d1f21bdc7cb1.jpg[/img]

Our game is currently purchasable through Steam! Important to state that the game is fully playable, but still in development. This means that those who choose to get the game now will be joining us while we learn what the community likes and expects from the game and use that to make it better for everyone.

It's going to be great to have the game accessible for players outside our Discord Community as well! Open development has been our thing for a while and we can't wait to open it even more. Talking about the community, big thanks to all of the members who helped us so far! You rock, honestly.

If you are interested in joining us along this Early Access journey, you can get the game with 15% OFF on the link below:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/400080/Out_of_Space/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/400080/Out_of_Space/[/url]

[h1]What is Out of Space?[/h1]

Strategy co-op multiplayer game about living on a spaceship with your roommates. You'll need to generate resources, take care of a deadly alien infestation, upgrade your appliances and build your own sustainable space home. Living together is never easy, especially when you are in outer space!

[h1]Why Early Access?[/h1]

Our process of developing games has always been very open to the community in the past. We usually show our games under development in more than 10 events throughout the year and we find that to be the best approach to making games. We want to make the game for the community, and instead of us trying to guess what you want, why not making it an open process?

Our project Out of Space has already benefited from the feedback of the community during its first versions. Since 2018 we're doing livestreams on Twitch/Youtube and keeping everyone engaged in our official Discord Server. 

By releasing this game in Early Access, we hope to continue to grow our community and get more people involved in its development.

[h1]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
[/h1]
We plan to have it on Early Access throughout 2019, but we're open to extend it depending on the community feedback.”

[h1]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
[/h1]
We want that the final version of the game to give a sense of completion to the player, with missions, achievements and unlockables, a complete tutorial and the ability to play with your friends or anyone online. The main goal is to make a game interesting enough to keep you going back for more for every match. Right now, we have a fun and almost feature complete match, but we lack persistence and progression to enhance the game’s replayability.

[h1]What is the current state of the Early Access version?
[/h1]
Out of Space contains the most important features of the in-game match: The ability to buy and build new technology, the need for taking care of your stamina/fatigue and your hunger, the procedural level generation, the basic resources, batteries and organic materials, also the basic enemy system and AI. Also, right now, the game is only playable as local multiplayer or solo.

[h1]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
[/h1]
We plan to have the game during Early Access with a fixed discount of 15%. After that, the game will be launched with the full price.

[h1]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
[/h1]
Our plan is to make the community a big part of the development process so, every 2 weeks we will have the same cycle of: 
- Gather and analyse all feedback and analytics from past cycle.
- Plan the current cycle of bug fixing, updates and features.
Inform the community on Discord and Steam Forums about the current cycle and upcoming features.
- Start production and continuously keep track of the community feedback.
- Every Thursday 4pm (EST), the dev team will do a live streaming about the upcoming changes (Twitch, Youtube and Steam)
- Launch a beta version to the most interested players, and then release the stable version to everyone else at the end of the cycle.

Please join our official Discord Server to talk to us and help us improve this game. [url=http://discord.gg/beholdstudios]http://discord.gg/beholdstudios[/url]

notes.title: SteamOS & Cloud Save is here for KoPP+1!
notes.notes:
Greetings, persons playing people playing characters. 

Today is a grand day, Knights of Pen and Paper +1 Edition is getting official SteamOS support! That means it will be 10 times* easier and more relaxing to play from your couch using one of those awesome Steam controller things.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Paradox Cloud Services (Log in via the black button on the menu screen to share your savegames between computers.)
[*]Steam Controller Optimization: Hid launcher settings window to allow start-up with only controller (Hold "Shift", "Ctrl" or "Alt" (on Mac) to trigger the window.)
[*]Miscellaneous bugfixes.
[/list]
[h1]Known issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Minor interraction issues between PDX account menu and Steam Controller. (Solve by logging in using mouse & keyboard once)
[*]The Steam Controller is only supported in mouse emulation mode.
[*]The Steam Controller is currently not supported on Mac and Linux. 
[/list]
We hope you all enjoy this addition to the game as much as we do.

Happy gaming! :)

Regards,
The KoPP Team

[i]*Experience may vary depending on quality of sofa and available snacks.[/i]

notes.title: Roll Perception to Detect Incoming Knights of Pen & Paper 2
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/LQkXq5T.png[/img]

World Randomly Encounters Exciting New Sequel to Classic Old-school Title

[B]STOCKHOLM — March 2, 2015 —[/B] Paradox Interactive, a publisher and developer with plenty of initiative, today announced the forthcoming release of [I]Knights of Pen & Paper 2[/I], coming to PC, iOS, and Android devices. [I]Knights of Pen & Paper 2[/I], the appropriately named sequel to [I]Knights of Pen & Paper +1 Edition[/I], will bring players back to the table, where they can sit and simulate another, different table inside the game (which is about a game). Danger, intrigue, death, role-playing, and roll-playing will return when [I]Knights of Pen & Paper 2[/I] arrives on May 14th.

Use the under-appreciated Appraise skill on this trailer: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s_cDGry31j0

Return to the dicey world of [I]Knights of Pen & Paper[/I] for a new turn-based adventure, where players get to take on the role of players, and also of the game’s encounter-designing, rules-lawering GM in a fully customizable party. Assemble a group of virtual friends, dress them in class-specific hats, and take on an all-new series of quests, including dynamic dungeons, an improved combat system, new loot and crafting mechanics, and more, as the party faces its greatest challenge yet: the new edition of the ruleset.

[I]Knights of Pen & Paper 2[/I] rolls with the following features:

[B]+2 to Impress:[/B] The retro adventure makes the leap from simulated 8-bit graphics to simulated 16-bit graphics, providing players with twice the bits
[B]New Racial Feats:[/B] Customize your party members by choosing players such as the Goth or the Rocker, classes such as Wizard or Thief, and for the first time, races such as Dwarves and Elves
[B]A Game of Throws:[/B] Face the whims of the d20 in an overhauled combat system, new crafting and loot, dynamically generated dungeons, and a variety of nail-biting saving throws
[B]Entirely Too Many Gaming and Pop Culture Jokes:[/B] Seriously

“When you allow people at your company to dress up in wizard robes and suits of armor, sometimes you wind up with games like [I]Knights of Pen & Paper 2[/I],” said Fredrik Wester, CEO of Paradox Interactive. “We’re going to be showing off the game in person this week at GDC. I wanted to reveal it during the DICE conference, but nobody agreed with me.”

For more information about [I]Knights of Pen & Paper 2[/I], visit www.knightsofpenandpaper.com

notes.title: Knights of Pen and Paper +1 Edition 2.08 Change Log
notes.notes:
- Fixed various crashes
- Some achievements fixed
- Increased achievement "Ain't nobody got time for that" from 365 to 465 days
- Fixed weakening spell on Black Dragon (negative damage for players made the dragon heal itself)
- Fixed Farmville in New Game + (Used to be 30 levels to high)
- The Consumable items list is now scrollable during combat when several items are listed
- Fixed some lower resistance effects
- "Miniatures" +1 to all skills bonus is now working as intended
- Blacksmith % dialogue now updated properly when using the +5% craft chance items
- Fixed some stat stacking not working or not showing the correct value
- Fixed some cases of the game crashing after killing elite mobs. Also related to Elite Kill achievement not working for everybody
- Achievement Dungeon Master now has an image
- Fixed a UI problem were using a character name and class that are both long caused text to overlap
- Localization - Portuguese - Fixed some strings that where to long
- You can no longer get stuck at Shipwreck Cove if you run out of money
- You can now leave Morderlägger Pit without abandoning the quest
- Paladin's Leader Strike skill now list the correct upgrade when leveling
- Fixed some +% Gold gained items not working
- Localization - Readability in character sheet for German translation updated slightly
- You can no longer skip combat by moving out of an area quickly

=)

notes.title: Now Available - Knights of Pen and Paper +1 Edition
notes.notes:
Knights of Pen and Paper +1 Edition is Now Available on Steam!

Set out on a grand adventure in this turn-based, retro style, pixel-art RPG, inspired by the great titles of the 90's. Take on the roles of in-game players taking on the roles of their characters in a traditional pen and paper RPG session in the ultimate meta roleplaying experience. Choose from multiple classes, such as knights and mages, pick your characters to control those classes, like grandma or kid brother, and take on the loads of quests, monsters, items and equipment littered throughout Knights of Pen & Paper +1 Edition. Blacksmiths, enchanters, mining, gathering, hidden treasures and a whole lot more await, giving players a lot of room to personalize their gameplay experience.

Don’t wait any longer, the Pen & Paper world needs you!
